|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20081225225012/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html Star Wars CCG cardlists index] at Decipher.com (archive, 25 December 2008)
* [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Light Character: Debnoli, Special Edition, R
|strategy=By James A. Van Fleet, RED 15<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20050317063356/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/specialedition/light/small/debnoli.html</ref>

Decipher continues to create wonderful new characters that can stand alone, without the help of Interrupts. The best thing about the game text of cards such as [[Debnoli]] is that it cannot be cancelled, Sensed or Altered!

Deploy 3, forfeit 4, power 3, ability 2 are good numbers for a pilot and warrior. Give [[Debnoli]] a [[Blaster Rifle]] and he is immune to attrition &lt;5, and can hit most characters with a destiny draw of 2, making them forfeit 0.

[[Debnoli]] and his partner [[Bron Burs]] could walk right through a Dark Deck relying on [[Tatooine: Jabba's Palace (Special Edition){{!}}Tatooine: Jabba's Palace]] strategies. They could hold the [[Jabba's Palace: Entrance Cavern]] against Gamorrean Guards, or clear out a nest of Abyssins or Skrillings.

Combos:

[[Debnoli]] + [[Blaster Rifle]] + [[Slight Weapons Malfunction]]. [[Debnoli]] shoots, he scores! He gets a battle destiny too.
